The change has one bug: `is_over` ignores sittings that run past midnight.

`is_over` returns `self.slot.day < today` for any booking on a different day (`src/booking/models/booking.rs:21-23`). A booking at 23:00 on day D runs until 00:30 on D+1. If `is_over(D+1, 00:10)` is called, the booking's day is earlier than today, so it returns true. The sitting still has 20 minutes left. Any start time after 22:30 is affected. The tests only cover a 19:00 start, so they miss this.
